Powder canister, stainless, welded. BOM "Powder hopper" is stainless and notes welds filed down. The Powder diagram's "Reservoir".

SealRing with o-ring groove; BOM "F-theta seal ring".

Z-axis motor plate. Name matches row 49 "Motor plate", but D-029 is the other candidate and the sheet is a degraded scan without outline dimensions.
